transfers._note: R-005 F-1, review G-1, D-024: the only ways ETH may leave a production contract. Each handler listed here must end with the one approved transfer (C-XFER), match every `required_before_send` pattern before it (C-XFER-ORDER), take exactly `params` and bind each name in `bindings` exactly once, by exactly that statement, and never rebind or assign a parameter or binding (C-XFER-SOURCE: the amount comes from storage and the payee is the caller's argument). Its `arm` must exist in the deployable production contract with exactly `arm_body` as its body, and nothing else in production may name the handler (C-XFER-ARM), so nothing runs after the transfer in the caller either. Only these handlers may require the Call effect (C-XFER-RAW).
